================================================================================
The example of usql
================================================================================

select 1 as n, 'two' as s from t where a = _v;

(source_file
  (select_statement

        (identifier))

================================================================================
The placeholders of the variables of usql
================================================================================

select _name, '_name', "_name", TRUE     from _tbl;

---

(source_file
  (select_statement
    (select
      (column_reference
        (identifier))
      (string)
      (column_reference
        (identifier))
      (boolean)
      (from_clause
        (table_reference
          (object_reference
            (identifier)))))))

================================================================================
The placeholders in a condition
================================================================================

select * from "_tbl" where TRUE      and _id = 1;

---

(source_file
  (select_statement
    (select
      (all_columns)
      (from_clause
        (table_reference
          (object_reference
            (identifier))))
      (where_clause
        (binary_expression
          (boolean)
          (binary_expression
            (column_reference
              (identifier))
            (operator)
            (number)))))))
